facts.claim: The 1906 census recorded 33,267 occupied houses and 10,633 unoccupied houses in Bombay.
facts.quote: According' to the census of 1906, there were 33,267 occupied houses and 10,633 unoccupied houses in Bombay*

facts.claim: Mahim, Varli, and Sion contained the largest number of primitive type huts.
facts.quote: Mahim, Varli and Sion contain the largest number of huts of a primitive type.
